Failed/cancelled refresh: previous result and metadata untouched
Serial save then clear: no resurrection
Two database connections: stale revision refused
V1 migration success; invalid V1 migration abort; future version rejected; blocked upgrade returns error
Updated event data recomputes matches, missing printing IDs stay pinned, and restored IDs recover
Multi-deck order, selection and per-deck filters retained across reopen
limitations: Full Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Safari and actual private-mode matrix remains WBS 9
Quota/denial and schema failures simulated with fake-indexeddb rather than filling the user browser disk
No offline app-shell guarantee or service worker
Browser data can be evicted or cleared; backups required for durable copies
No GitHub repository, cloud deployment, paid resources or credential changes in this WBS
